node.title: Deep-point identity BadVec = Deep_alpha^mu (x1)
node.statement: [transcribed 2026-07-27 from the upstream source read via git -C ../rs-mca show origin/main:experimental/notes/roadmaps/proof_sketch/s7_list_side.md#3, tagged 'PROVED-cited (mine) + verified budgets']. THE DEEP-POINT IDENTITY: BadVec = Deep_alpha^mu.
